title: Salesforce Engineering Manager (Belarus)
description:
We're looking for a Salesforce technical architect and engineering manager who can drive development velocity across a team of 10 to 15 engineers building enterprise applications on the Salesforce Platform. • Strong Node.js background and a clear point of view on building maintainable services and integrations at scale.

• Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using modern APIs and integration patterns.

title: Engineering Manager, Data Foundations
description:
Ready to be a Titan?
We're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our Data Foundations team - the team responsible for data ingestion, data quality, and cost management across ServiceTitan 's data platform. You'll stay hands-on and technically engaged, guiding architecture personally rather than delegating it, while building and leading a team of strong engineers across the US and India.
What You'll Do

• Lead and Mentor: Manage and grow a team of 5+ data engineers spanning multiple regions and time zones. Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and build a team culture rooted in ownership and psychological safety.

• Hands-On Technical Leadership: Stay hands-on - review architecture and code, prototype solutions to hard problems, and personally guide the team's technical direction rather than delegating all design work.

• Architecture, Data Quality & Cost: Drive architecture for data ingestion (Kafka, custom ETL Agent), Snowflake, and Airflow; own the strategy for data quality tooling and monitoring; and lead cost optimization efforts, balancing efficiency with reliability and long-term platform health.

• Operations & Stakeholder Collaboration: Own the operational posture of the platform - monitoring, alerting, incident response, and on-call - while championing data governance best practices and partnering with product, architecture, and business stakeholders to deliver the roadmap.

What You'll Bring

• Experience: 8+ years in data or software engineering, with 2+ years managing engineering teams of 5 or more.

• Building & Leading Global Teams: Proven experience building and leading engineering teams across multiple regions and time zones, with strong async-first habits and comfort setting technical direction without relying on overlapping hours.

• Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with Cloud Providers, Kubernetes, Kafka, Snowflake, Iceberg/Delta/Hudi, Airflow, and Python; a strong grasp of distributed systems trade-offs; and experience architecting data ingestion, quality, and cost-optimization solutions at scale.

• Communication & Collaboration: Direct, empathetic, and outcome-focused. Able to align cross-functional stakeholders, articulate technical trade-offs, and influence architectural direction without direct authority.

Nice to Have

• Experience with CDC patterns and tooling (Debezium or similar).

• Familiarity with dbt or modern transformation frameworks.

• Prior experience building or standing up a new team or engineering hub in a new region.

• Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) or building AI-powered agents for operational use cases.

‌
Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.

title: Senior Privacy Engineer
description:
About Upstart

At Upstart , we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstart ers the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:
Upstart ’s Privacy Engineering team builds the systems, tools, and technical controls that help protect borrower, applicant, partner, and Upstart er data across our products and platforms. The team works across Engineering, Security, Legal, Compliance, Product, Data, and Machine Learning to make privacy-by-design practical and scalable.
As a Privacy Engineer II at Upstart , you will build software and services that embed privacy controls into the core architecture of Upstart ’s products and technical systems. You will help implement privacy-enhancing technologies, data minimization patterns, and governance tooling that support responsible data use across Upstart ’s AI lending marketplace.
How you’ll make an impact

• Design, build, and operate privacy engineering services that support user control, data governance, anonymization, pseudonymization, retention, deletion, and auditability

• Implement privacy-by-design patterns and data minimization controls across Upstart ’s products, services, data pipelines, and machine learning systems

• Build APIs, libraries, services, and developer tools that help engineering teams standardize privacy enforcement across the technology stack

You build systems that make AI predictable, controllable, and production-ready-especially in visual domains.

• Strong experience with generative AI systems (diffusion models, conditioning, latent space control)

• Solid programming skills (Python, PyTorch) with experience shipping working systems

• Experience training or fine-tuning models and managing their lifecycle

• Exposure to visual tools like Photoshop, Blender, or similar (not optional thinking-actual usage)

You Think:

• In systems, not prompts-how components interact, fail, and scale

• In constraints-how to guide models toward predictable outputs

• In outputs-what makes something production-ready vs. visually interesting

• Pragmatically-you ship working solutions and refine based on results

Your Skills Are:

• Translating abstract creative direction into structured AI workflows

• Debugging generation pipelines across multiple control layers

Why Join Grip?
The Platform Position.
Grip is infrastructure for enterprise creative production-powering global brands to generate content at scale with control and consistency.

AI-generated content is moving from experimentation to production. The challenge is no longer generation-it’s control, reliability, and scale.

You’ll work with ComfyUI-based workflows, multi-tenant architecture, and a stack spanning TypeScript, Python, Elixir, and C#-built for production, not demos.

title: Enquêteur ou enquêteuse en situation de crise communautaire
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

La communauté que vous rejoindrez :
Les enquêteurs en situation de crise communautaire constituent la première ligne d’intervention d’Airbnb face aux incidents les plus graves touchant notre communauté : menaces de violence, escalades en matière de sécurité et événements qui exposent les voyageurs, les hôtes ou l’entreprise à des risques importants. Dans ce rôle, vous ferez le lien entre un incident et les personnes et ressources capables de le résoudre, puis vous veillerez à l’exécution complète des mesures approuvées, afin que le préjudice causé à notre communauté cesse le plus tôt possible.

La différence que vous ferez :
À titre d’enquêteur ou d’enquêteuse en situation de crise communautaire, vous allez gérer votre propre charge de dossiers et dirigez l’intervention au quotidien, avec un point de validation défini pour les décisions qui créent un précédent ou comportent une exposition publique. Vous évaluez les incidents et partagez avec l’équipe ce que vous avez appris.

Une journée type :

Traitement des dossiers de crise

• Évaluer les incidents entrants et recommander si un dossier atteint le seuil de mise en œuvre du protocole de crise, en rédigeant des résumés assez concis et complets pour que le décideur puisse agir sans avoir à les retourner pour obtenir des précisions.

• Définir et piloter les mesures de gestion de dossiers nécessaires pour que les parties prenantes puissent intervenir efficacement, en respectant l’échéancier de l’incident.

• Rechercher les précédents et consulter les parties prenantes lorsqu’un dossier ne correspond pas à un modèle établi, et présenter l’option recommandée avec son raisonnement plutôt qu’une question ouverte.

• Préparer des aperçus concis et les prochaines étapes pour les dossiers urgents, sous surveillance ou activés, et signaler les mises à jour d’équipe ou les points administratifs lors des rencontres régionales.

Communication et gestion des parties prenantes

• Rédiger les communications relatives aux dossiers de crise destinées aux parties prenantes de haut niveau, et fournir les détails du dossier et l’évaluation sur lesquels reposent les notes d’information à la direction.

• Tenir les parties prenantes et la direction de la gestion mondiale des crises (Global Crisis Management, GCM) au courant de l’état des dossiers de façon proactive, avant même qu’elles ne le demandent.

• Assurer la communication quotidienne avec vos partenaires interfonctionnels attitrés : maintenir un contact régulier, vous présenter aux rencontres préparé, avec un ordre du jour établi et transmettre à l’équipe mondiale de la GCM ce que vous apprenez.

Amélioration systémique

• Signaler les cas où une politique, un produit ou un processus a fait défaut à un membre de la communauté, avec suffisamment de précision pour que l’équipe responsable puisse agir. L’objectif est de combler la lacune qui a permis l’incident, et pas seulement de résoudre l’incident.

• Maintenir l’exactitude de l’outil de gestion de cas pour vos propres dossiers et signaler les problèmes de données ou de retards de traitement que vous remarquez, afin que la vue d’ensemble de l’équipe sur la charge de travail mondiale demeure fiable.

Contribution à l’équipe

• Réviser les évaluations de vos collègues avant leur soumission, à titre de deuxième regard, en vérifiant les erreurs, les parties prenantes manquantes et les recommandations qui gagneraient à être ajoutées.

• Partager avec l’équipe ce que vous apprenez de vos dossiers et de vos relations avec les parties prenantes.

• Contribuer à la culture d’équipe et à un environnement de travail où les gens peuvent accompli

title: Senior Full-Stack Angular / NodeJS Web Developer - Full Remote - Contractor
Revenue Accounting Manager
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

ABOUT YOU

Our revenue is credit-denominated and consumption-based - usage billing, prepaid credit drawdown, and concurrency pricing across a growing enterprise base - which is close to the most complex revenue profile in infrastructure software. The load-bearing questions are open and there are few set policies and processes.

You will be the technical authority on revenue. You will own the entire Order to Cash cycle, from interfacing with our sales team, reviewing contracts, assessing terms in accordance with ASC 606, implementing workpapers and schedules, documenting conclusions, and assisting with billing and collection efforts. If building processes from square one and taking ownership of some of the most complex revenue arrangements excites you, this is the role for you.

You'll thrive as a Revenue Accounting Manager if you:

- are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

- are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

- work hard and can build and ship fast

- are focused on polish, detail and quality

- are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Author our revenue accounting policy set - principal versus agent on brokered inference, breakage on expiring credits, performance obligation identification and allocation, minimum commitment versus overage, and contract modifications - and make each one stand up to an external auditor

- Own the monthly revenue close: recognition, the deferred revenue rollforward, contract asset and liability balances, and the flux analysis

- Own the revenue portion of our external audit, from the PBC list through the technical positions

- Replace manual revenue entries with an automated billing-to-revenue reconciliation and a documented exception process - revenue should be computed by a system and reviewed by a person, with invoice accuracy above 99% and root-cause tracking on the misses

- Govern order to cash: billing accuracy, dispute resolution, and an AR and collections process with real DSO and aging targets

- Own commission capitalization and amortization under ASC 340-40

- Review non-standard deal structures before they're signed, so the accounting consequence is a decision rather than a discovery

WHO YOU ARE

- You're a licensed CPA with a Big 4 or comparable technical accounting foundation, plus real industry experience in a high-growth startup environment

- You have demonstrable ASC 606 experience with usage-based or consumption revenue

- You write technical memos that a reviewer can follow without a meeting: facts, guidance, analysis, conclusion

- Experience assessing GAAP guidance and implementing it in real-world situations

- You've owned a monthly revenue close hands-on, and you've closed revenue through at least one external audit

- You're comfortable being the technical authority without a bench behind you

NICE TO HAVE

- Billing system implementation or migration - Metronome, Stripe, Zuora

- Pre-IPO or first-audit experience

- Enough SQL to validate a recognition schedule against raw usage data yourself

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

- Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law

description:

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Corporate Technical team is responsible for building and optimizing the many systems and internal technologies that enable Anduril to accomplish its mission. Anduril’s supply chain, accounting, sales & growth, field maintenance, manufacturing, and many more teams rely on the technology built and maintained by us. We call this system-of-systems “CorpOS”. Within CorpOS lies a suite of digital software solutions aimed at solving the problems for our growth, finance, people teams that interplays heavily with our ArsenalOS solutions that enable Anduril’s engineering, production and sustainment departments.

ABOUT THE JOB

We're building the financial systems backbone that lets a fast-scaling manufacturing company move with the speed of a software startup and the rigor of a public company. As Finance Solutions Manager, you'll sit at the intersection of Finance, Operations, and Engineering-owning the platforms, data, and processes that turn raw operational activity into trustworthy financial insight. This is a builder's role:

• You'll inherit ambiguity, systems that do and don't yet talk to each other, and a business growing faster than its tooling

• Your mandate is to close that gap with scalable ERP workflows, clean cost and revenue data, and automation that replaces spreadsheets and manual reconciliation

• You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with controllers, FP&A, supply chain, and data engineering-translating messy real-world requirements into systems that are auditable, performant, and built to last through the next order of magnitude of growth

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

•  Own the design and continuous improvement of core finance systems-ERP (e.g., Oracle Fusion, NetSuite, SAP), cost accounting, and the data pipelines feeding FP&A and reporting

•  Partner with Finance and Operations stakeholders to gather requirements, then translate them into configured, tested, well-documented solutions rather than one-off workarounds

•  Lead cross-functional projects end to end: entity setups, cost and receipt accounting flows, work-order and inventory costing, order-to-cash and procure-to-pay improvements

•  Build the connective tissue between transactional systems and analytics-defining the data models, controls, and reconciliations that make month-end fast and the numbers defensible

•  Drive automation and self-service, cutting manual close tasks and giving finance partners direct access to reliable data

•  Establish standards for change management, testing, and documentation so the platform stays clean as the team scales

•  Act as the bridge between Finance and Engineering/Data teams, ensuring technical decisions reflect real accounting and operational needs

•  Mentor analysts and set the bar for how finance systems work gets done

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

•  5+ years in finance systems, finance operations, technical accounting, or a closely related field, including hands-on ownership of an ERP or financial platform

•  Demonstrated experience designing and implementing finance solutions end to end-requirements through deployment and adoption-not just administering existing systems

•  Strong grounding in accounting fundamentals: general led

title: Praktikum im Bereich Fundraising/Veranstaltungen
description:
Du hast Lust auf ein Praktikum, bei dem du dich für den Klimaschutz einsetzen kannst? Dann melde dich bei uns! Wir suchen insbesondere von Februar bis April eine:n Praktikant:in im Bereich Veranstaltungsorganisation für unser jährliches Frühlingsfest.
Mögliche Aufgaben:

• Du unterstützt das Fundraising-Team in allen relevanten Aspekten der Veranstaltungsplanung, -durchführung und -nachbereitung.

• Du hast noch weitere Ideen, wie wir unsere Veranstaltungen für unsere Unterstützer:innen so spannend wie möglich machen können? Super, wir freuen uns über deinen Input!

• Wenn du darüber hinaus Lust hast, in weitere Fundraising-Themen reinzuschnuppern, hast du dazu in unserem Team ebenfalls die Gelegenheit.

• Du bist sicher und schnell im Erstellen von Texten.

• Du bist kommunikationsfreudig und gehst gerne auf Menschen zu.

• Du hast erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Spender:innen gemacht oder bringst sehr viel Lust mit, dich in das Thema Fundraising einzuarbeiten.

• Du bist ein:e Teamplayer:in und arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert. Du erkennst kritische Grenzen, bei denen du nach Unterstützung oder Feedback fragst.

• Dir liegt der Klimaschutz am Herzen und du hast richtig viel Lust, anderen Menschen das Thema näher zu bringen.

• Du willst Menschen zeigen, wie wichtig das Engagement durch Spenden für gemeinnützige Organisationen ist.

Achtung: Das Praktikum ist nicht vergütet. Wir arbeiten daran, zukünftig Praktikant:innen zumindest eine Aufwandsentschädigung bezahlen zu können. Sobald das eine Option ist, werden wir diesen Text hier anpassen.

Haben wir dich neugierig gemacht? Dann werde Zeronaut:in und arbeite gemeinsam mit uns am Ziel, das Pariser Klimaversprechen einzuhalten und Deutschland mit konkreten Lösungen klimaneutral zu machen. Was wir schätzen, sind Vielfalt und Offenheit, Professionalität, Tatkraft und Effizienz und vor allem den Antrieb, die Klimakrise nicht weiter eskalieren zu lassen. Denn was uns alle eint, ist der unbedingte Wille, unser Ziel zu erreichen.
Bitte sende uns einen Lebenslauf und ein Anschreiben zu, aus dem Deine Motivation deutlich wird.
GermanZero e.V. ist eine führende Klimaschutzorganisation, die sich einem großen Ziel verschrieben hat: Wir machen Deutschland bis 2035 klimaneutral. Wir sind an der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft, Politik und Zivilgesellschaft tätig und setzen dabei auf innovative Strategien und dynamische Kollaboration, um nachhaltige Veränderungen zu bewirken. Mit konstruktiven Lösungsangeboten wollen wir die Umsetzung einer effektiven Klimapolitik vorantreiben.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

About Grafana Labs: 

There are more than 700,000 active installations of Grafana around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps. The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a SpaceX launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France. Grafana Labs also helps companies including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay manage their observability strategies with full-stack offerings that can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud, or self-managed with Grafana Enterprise Stack. The Grafana stack has grown to include more open-source projects, including Grafana Loki (for logs) and Grafana Tempo (for traces) and Grafana Mimir (for metrics).

Description of Duties

We’re looking for a Staff Technical Writer to create documentation and learning content that helps people adopt and master Grafana’s observability products. You’ll work with engineers, product managers, and the Grafana writing team to produce content for a range of products and audiences, from first-time users to experienced practitioners. Because our products and priorities evolve, we’re looking for someone who learns new technical domains quickly.

AI is part of how this team works. We use AI-assisted workflows and tools throughout the content lifecycle, from research and drafting to review, validation, and maintenance. You’ll use these tools every day and help the team get better at using them.

Key Responsibilities

• Plan, research, write, and maintain documentation and learning content (concepts, tasks, tutorials, references, and in-product learning) that supports adoption and long-term product mastery.

• Use AI tools and workflows to work faster and at a higher quality: drafting, structuring, technical validation, consistency checks, and keeping content current. You apply human judgment to everything AI produces and take responsibility for its accuracy.

• Contribute to the team’s shared AI workflows and skills, and look for ways to improve and automate how we create and maintain content as tools and models evolve.

• Partner with engineers, PMs, and other stakeholders to understand product requirements, interview subject matter experts, and turn complex technical detail into clear, accurate content.

• Test what you document. Run the software, follow your own procedures, and flag product and UX gaps you find along the way.

• Let data guide your priorities. We have strong docs and learning analytics. You’ll use them, along with user feedback, to find content gaps, prioritize your work, and show the impact of what you ship.

• Work with the documentation

title: Compensation Programs & Operations Lead
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Compensation team helps attract, reward, and retain the people advancing our mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. We develop compensation strategies and programs that support a rapidly evolving business, combining market insight, sound judgment, and thoughtful execution. We partner across People, Finance, Legal, and the business to deliver programs that employees and leaders can understand and trust.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Compensation Programs & Operations Lead to own the end-to-end program management of our cyclical and ad hoc compensation programs globally. You will turn compensation priorities into executable plans and lead delivery from initial scoping through launch, reconciliation, and continuous improvement.

This is a senior, hands-on role for a compensation subject-matter expert who is energized by operations and E2E program ownership. You should bring experience across compensation operations analysis, compensation analysis, business partnership, and program management. Having done this work yourself, you understand the practical details behind compensation decisions and what it takes to implement them accurately.

You will establish how our compensation programs run: the calendar, responsibilities, systems requirements, controls, communications, and handoffs that connect program design to the employee experience. You’ll partner closely with Compensation Partners, HR Business Partners, People Operations, People Technology, Finance, Payroll, Equity Administration, and Legal, creating clarity and driving execution as priorities evolve.

In this role, you will:

- Lead our compensation program portfolio. Own the integrated roadmap and calendar for cyclical and ad hoc programs, including compensation reviews, bonus and equity cycles, promotion-related compensation processes, recognition and retention initiatives, and new program launches.

- Drive programs from planning through completion. Define scope, deliverables, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, and resource needs. Coordinate work across teams, resolve blockers, and bring decisions and tradeoffs to the right owners early.

- Translate compensation expertise into practical operations. Work with Compensation Partners and program owners to turn approved designs into clear eligibility rules, calculations, workflows, approval paths, and exception processes. Identify gaps and implementation risks before launch.

- Stay close to the analysis and data. Build and review models, validate inputs and calculations, investigate discrepancies, and reconcile final outcomes. Be comfortable working directly in the details when a program needs it.

- Build reliable execution controls. Establish quality checks, documented approvals, access controls, and audit trails. Coordinate accurate handoffs to Payroll, Equity Administration, and People Operations, with clear ownership through completion.

- Shape compensation systems and tooling. Translate business needs into requirements, partner with People Technology on configuration and integrations, lead user acceptance testing, and prioritize improvements that reduce manual work and errors.

- Manage incoming requests and changing priorities. Create a practical intake and prioritization process for ad hoc compensation initiatives. Make capacity, timing, and dependencies visible so urgent work can be delivered alongside recurring commitments.

- Make programs easier to understand and use. Develop operating guides, manager resources, communications, and training. Equip Compensation Partners and other stakeholders to explain programs consistently and resolve questions efficiently.

- Improve how the function operates. Measure accuracy, timeliness, manual effort, and stakeholder experience. Run post-cycle reviews and turn findings into simpler processes, stronger documentation, and effective automation.

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners .
We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs-from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations-rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023 , Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue , with a clear path to profitability by late 2026 . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.
Our customers are affluent business owners ($3-$200M in revenue) -the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better-not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.
Team & Locations
We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About the role

Flex moves real money at a serious scale, and someone has to make sure it only moves for the right reasons. We're hiring our first Financial Crimes Analysts to be that someone, and to build the function around them.

This is a net-new role. You'll report directly to the Head of Financial Crimes and work side by side with the people who designed our financial crime program. Once a customer is through the door, you own what happens next: monitoring their activity, investigating what looks wrong, deciding what is suspicious, and writing the narrative that backs the decision.

Your first priority will be working through our alert and case backlog and keeping the queue moving, which means a lot of hands-on investigation from day one. Our processes are still being built, so you'll also notice what's clunky, document it, and help simplify it. As the backlog comes under control, you'll have more room for bigger improvements. The scope is broader than a typical analyst role because the function is still taking shape, and the people who join first will set its standards and its reputation with our partners.

This is a strong fit if you have a few years of hands-on financial crimes experience, enjoy digging into cases, and want to grow from running a process into helping design one, with a clear path into broader program responsibilities as the team grows.

What you'll own

You'll be a core part of financial crime detection and investigation at Flex .

• Post-onboarding risk. Own the question "is this customer's activity legitimate?" from the moment an alert fires to the moment it is cleared, escalated, or filed.

• The queue and the backlog. Your first priority is working through our alert backlog and keeping the queue current, with an eye on both quality and speed, so real risk gets the scrutiny it deserves and good customers aren't slowed down by noise.

• The investigation standard. Help set the bar for what a strong case narrative looks like here: clear, well supported, and defensible to a regulator or bank partner without a follow-up call.

• Detection coverage. Flag the typologies, patterns, and blind spots you see across cases and bring them to Risk, Operations, and Engineering, so they can become better rules and fewer false positives.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

- A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

- PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

- Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog.

 

THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

- Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

- Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

- Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams - autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

- Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication - PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

- Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for a Technical Support Engineer who loves helping customers and can't leave a problem alone until it's solved.

You're an engineer who happens to do support. You pick up new things fast and you're comfortable with a problem nobody has seen before. That matters more to us than your previous job title, and people on our team came to support from various backgrounds.

You care about how a customer feels when they leave the conversation, not only whether the ticket closed. You take feedback well, say when you don't know something yet, and learn from anyone on t

Once practitioners are in the OR, our Surgical Suite enables real-time remote access and creates a secure video record of every procedure; improving training, education, and collaboration. • Assess the Delivery implications of new deals, expansions, and contractual commitments so they are achievable and economically sound.

title: Associate Producer
description:
About High Scale
We’re High Scale - a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition-that’s the DNA behind everything we do.
Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026-and we need an Associate Producer who is the ultimate organizer, anticipating needs and keeping our high-velocity production engine running smoothly.
Why This Role Matters
Momentum, organization, and details are your playground. As an Associate Producer, you are the right hand of the Production team. You operate in the trenches, ensuring that briefs are clear, assets are organized, timelines are met, and quality is maintained.
You are the glue that holds the creative process together. While the Senior Producers look at the big picture, you ensure no detail slips through the cracks. Your work directly impacts our efficiency and speed to market. If you are a master multi-tasker looking to learn the ropes of high-end commercial production from the inside out, this is your launchpad.
What You’ll Do

•
Support End-to-End Production

• Assist Senior Producers in managing the daily workflow of video campaigns, from project kickoff to final delivery.

• Track the status of dozens of simultaneous projects, updating project management boards (Asana, ClickUp, Notion) in real-time.

• Flag potential blockers or delays immediately and work to resolve them before they impact the deadline.

•
Asset Management & Organization

• Act as the gatekeeper for creative assets. Ensure raw footage, music, scripts, and brand guidelines are organized and accessible to the editing team.

• Perform quality checks on incoming assets from creators and outgoing deliverables from editors (checking for correct specs, spelling, and audio levels).

•
Coordinate Creative Teams

• Serve as a liaison between the creative team (editors, designers) and the account team.

• Translate feedback into clear, actionable notes for editors to execute.

• Ensure creative briefs are fully populated with all necessary information before production begins.

•
Resource & Vendor Support

• Assist in sourcing voice-over talent, stock footage, or specialized freelancers as needed.

• Handle administrative tasks related to production, such as contract management, release forms, and invoicing.

Who You Are

•
A Rising Production Talent

• 1-3 years of experience in production, project management, or account coordination (agency or digital media preferred).

• You have a basic understanding of the video production lifecycle (Pre-Pro, Production, Post).

•
The Most Organized Person in the Room

• You love checklists, spreadsheets, and color-coded calendars.

• You have an obsession with file naming conventions and folder structures.

•
Proactive Problem Solver

• You don’t wait to be told what to do. You see a gap in the process or a missing file, and you fix it.

• You are "solution-first" in your communication style.

•
Tech-Savvy

• Proficient in project management tools (Asana, Monday, ClickUp) and Google Suite.

• Familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere,) is a massive plus, even if you aren't an editor.

•
Excellent Communicator

• Strong English proficiency is required. You are clear, concise, and professional in Slack, email, and Zoom. You know how to chase people for deliverables without being annoying.

Perks & Benefits

• Growth Opportunities: This is the training ground for becoming a Senior Producer. Master the details, and the path upward is clear.

• Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunit

You will lead sprint planning, product kickoffs, cross-team project check-ins, and product launches. title: Senior Content Strategist
description:
ABOUT HIYA

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Hiya is hiring a Senior Content Strategist to own how we use content to reach, engage, and convert buyers across our markets and audiences. You'll own the strategy and the craft. You'll decide what we publish and why, then write and edit the pieces that matter most yourself. You'll work across product marketing, sales, demand generation, and our audience teams to turn what we know about customers into content that earns attention and moves pipeline.

Because so much discovery now happens through search engines and AI answer platforms, a core part of the job is making sure Hiya's content is what gets found and cited. You'll write and structure what we publish so it's clear, credible, and legible to both the people and the machines doing the reading. We want you to have a strong point of view on content for humans vs. content for machines, and when those should be different things.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who wants to build a content function, not inherit one. You geek out on AI and what’s new in content, and taking big bold swings excites you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

title: Product Engineer (100% Remote)
description:
In most companies a developer gets a ticket, builds it and moves on to the next one. Someone else talked to the customer, someone else decided what gets built, and whether it actually helped is someone else's question.
We're looking for developers who want to do the whole job: talk to the people who use the software, decide what to build, build it and stay on it until it works for them. That's what we mean by product engineer. We took the term from PostHog, who describe it well in their Product Engineer Handbook.
About us
is software for property management companies in Germany. Inbox, CRM, documents, telephony, video calls, team chat and AI agents in one platform, so property managers can do their daily work in one place. We're a small team based in Worms, Germany, working fully remote. We're self-funded and profitable.
What a product engineer does here

• You talk to customers. You read the support requests and feedback for your area, look at how customers use it and talk to them directly. Nobody filters it for you.

• You decide what to build. For your area you decide what comes next, based on what customers need and what matters for the company. You write down why, so the team can follow and give feedback.

• You ship early. The first version goes to a few customers as soon as it's useful. Then you improve it based on what they say and do.

• You build all of it. Data model, backend, frontend and UI. The result has to be clean, simple and intuitive to use, not only working.

• You do support for your area. When something breaks or a customer is stuck, you fix it and tell them it's fixed.

• You check whether it worked. Your job isn't done when the feature is live. You look at whether customers use it and whether it solved their problem.

• You automate what you can. When a customer asks a support question, you add the answer to our knowledge base and update our internal agent, so next time it's handled automatically. A lot already runs on its own here, bug fixes are already processed semi-automatically, and we keep automating more.

Examples of what you could work on

• A customer wants to bring their old file storage into our document management, with their own folder structure and thousands of documents, and it should be fast and AI-supported. You look at how they've organized their files, build the import as a general feature for all customers, set it up for them and test it with their folder structure. Then you check whether the AI assigned every document to the right building, apartment or contact and fix what doesn't fit.

• A customer reports that the inbox agent gave a tenant a wrong answer. You look at what the agent did, fix the tool or its instructions and let the customer know.

• Only a few customers build their own agents in the sandbox. You find out why, by looking at the data and talking to customers, make the setup simpler and check whether more customers use it afterwards.

• Property managers do the same task fifty times a day and it takes too many clicks. You notice it, talk to them about how they work and make it faster.

Our tech stack
Everything is TypeScript, from the database schema to the frontend.
Backend: Convex (database & serverless functions)
Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
Agents: Vercel AI SDK, LiveKit for voice
You'll build with Claude and get as many AI tokens as you need.
Salary

• $1500 - $3000 per month before taxes with room for growth and promotion in the months & years ahead

• Permanent employment contract in your country of residence through our partner Deel (EOR)

Benefits

• 100% remote work

• Flexible hours

• Self-funded & profitable, no VC money to burn through

• Small team, what you build goes live

• Quick decisions, no pointless meetings and no layers of approval

Our Health Program

• Private room in hospital, worldwide coverage

• Free choice of doctors & specialists, no health check, pre-existing conditions don't matter

• Partner and kids are covered as

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About Rebar

Rebar is building the AI operating system for commercial HVAC, Electrical, and Plumbing.

Over the past year, our quoting platform has processed tens of thousands of projects across North America, and we’ve doubled our revenue in the first six weeks of this year. Our customers include many of the industry's top firms. Some of these companies run billion-dollar construction projects on workflows that still look like they did in 1985.

Construction is 10% of GDP and still massively underserved by software. We are changing that.

We recently raised a $14M Series A from leading construction tech investors and are entering our next phase of growth. We are building a set of AI-native products that will define how this industry operates.

We are looking for a Client Success Manager who wants to build real products, move fast, and take ownership early. You will help define how AI changes one of the largest industries in the world.

What You’ll Do

- Support and Lead Client Trainings: help deliver virtual and in-person trainings, then run sessions on your own as you ramp

- Learn the Industry: shadow implementations, client calls, and onsite kickoffs to understand how our customers estimate, quote, and run their businesses. Work towards owning onboardings and implementations from kick-off to go-live.

- Own Day-to-Day Client Communication: answer inbound questions over email, live chat, video calls, and tickets with fast, accurate, helpful responses

- Build Training Content: create and maintain tutorials, short videos, FAQs, and guides that make complex features easy to adopt for technical and non-technical users

- Keep Onboardings on Track: manage tasks, follow-ups, and timelines in our CRM and ticketing tools, and flag adoption blockers early

- Be the Voice of the Customer: capture feedback from trainings and calls and share it with Product, Engineering, and Sales

- Grow Into Full Implementations: take ownership of onboardings from Sales handoff through go-live as your knowledge grows

What You Bring

- 1-3 years in a client-facing SaaS Implementation, Onboarding, Client Success, or Client Training role

- Experience training or onboarding external clients, or presenting software to end users

- Clear, confident communication: you can explain technical concepts simply and stay calm when a client is frustrated

- Strong organization and follow-through across several clients at once

- Eagerness to learn a technical industry and real interest in construction and the trades

- Comfort working onsite in NYC full-time, with occasional travel to client sites

Bonus

- Exposure to construction, HVAC, MEP, or another technical/industrial industry

- Experience creating training content (videos, docs, workshops)

- Familiarity with HubSpot, Intercom, or similar CRM and support tools

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

- Build foundational knowledge of the product, core workflows, and our customer segments (manufacturer reps, distributors, and mechanical, plumbing, and controls contractors)

- Shadow client calls, trainings, and onboardings with the implementation team

- Begin handling common client questions over chat and email

First 60 Days

- Confidently demo core product features

- Co-lead client trainings with the Director or Senior Implementation Manager

- Contribute at least one new training asset (video, guide, or FAQ)

First 90 Days

- Run client trainings independently

- Lead smaller implementations end to end, from Sales handoff through go-live

- Build toward owning full implementations and onsite kickoffs

- Own day-to-day communication for a set of onboarding clients

- Manage tasks and timelines for onboardings with support from senior team members

Compensation & Benefits

- Competitive salary based on experience

- Equity: meaningful grant, aligned with your background

- Benefits: medical, dental, vision

- Perks: free lunches and dinners
